findings.name: known_label_proxies_excluded_from_features
findings.meaning: Generator latent strength, final outcomes, and the regression target are derived from the label and must never be used as model inputs — using them inflates metrics without learning.

findings.name: exclusion_set_covers_all_known_proxies
findings.meaning: The EXCLUDED_COLUMNS denylist in complete_synthetic_training.py is the single source of truth for what cannot be a feature. Any known proxy not in that set is a latent regression risk.

findings.name: patient_cycle_pair_is_unique
findings.meaning: (patient_id, cycle) is the natural primary key for temporal training rows.  Any duplicate biases metrics by overweighting those visits.

findings.name: feature_columns_present
findings.meaning: The training feature contract must resolve to columns in temporal_ml_rows.csv.

findings.name: no_future_or_label_named_features
findings.meaning: Feature names should not include final outcomes, labels, or assessment-only variables.

findings.name: excluded_columns_not_used_as_features
findings.meaning: Outcome and bookkeeping columns may exist in the dataset but must not be used by the model.

findings.name: one_row_per_patient_cycle
findings.meaning: Duplicate patient-cycle rows can leak repeated labels or overweight specific visits.

findings.name: cycle_order_monotonic_by_patient
findings.meaning: Temporal rows should be ordered by observed treatment cycle.

findings.name: treatment_dates_follow_cycle_order
findings.meaning: Later cycles should not have earlier treatment dates.

findings.name: response_regression_label_is_mri_transform
findings.meaning: The continuous response label is a transparent transform of the observed MRI percent-change signal.

interpretation: A passing audit means the configured feature contract and patient-aware split are free of the known engineering leakage patterns.  It is not a guarantee of clinical validity; only real-world prospective validation can establish that.
claim_boundary: Engineering evidence only.  Synthetic dataset audit; does not establish absence of clinical leakage in real patient records.
